frozen_settings.init_F_scale_note: applied to EVERY config including all-Gaussian, so that initialisation does not covary with the family composition under comparison; the core runner applied it only for discrete X

seed_policy.model: model_seed = data_seed + 50 (independent of k_est and config)
seed_policy.x_stream: X drawn from default_rng(data_seed + 500000), a separate stream so that changing the family composition cannot perturb Z, F or Y

estimator.lineage_note: per-column prototype (fixed -> masked -> percolumn) with objective-consistent numerics. PROTOTYPE, not a manuscript method (root CLAUDE.md section 3). KI-015 requires numerics_mode='consistent' for new per-column experiments.
estimator.criterion_fn: eval_utils.calc_Q_dual_strict_exp + calc_bic_exp; Q-based complete-data criterion, NOT a Schwarz BIC (KI-010)

comparability.vs_canonical_core: NOT numerically comparable. The core used calc_bic_dual, which omits the Gaussian-Y -0.5*ln(2pi) per-pair constant that calc_Q_dual_strict_exp includes. The parity audit measured the offset at +20538.2762 on the criterion, constant in K, so argmin is unaffected but absolute scores must never be merged.
